analysis.summary: GNA Axles Limited reported a revenue of ` 1,478.42 Cr and a PAT of ` 116.99 Cr for the financial year 2025-26, reflecting a revenue decrease of around 4% alongside improved bottom-line earnings. Management highlighted robust domestic demand from tractor and commercial vehicle manufacturers, which helped offset export pressures caused by US tariffs. The company also established GNA Mobility Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to expand its product portfolio into passenger and light vehicles, while increasing its rooftop solar energy capacity to 6 MW. GNA Axles Limited reported net revenue of ` 1,539.74 Cr and an EBITDA of ` 210.61 Cr for the financial year 2024-25, alongside the incorporation of a new wholly-owned subsidiary, GNA Mobility Limited, in February 2025. Management noted an export volume growth of around 13.50% in 2024-25, supported by increased market share and strategic focus on global markets.

guidance.claim: Management expects domestic tractor sales to post lower single-digit growth during the year due to expected good monsoon and higher farm incomes.
guidance.quote: As far as the Domestic Tractor Market is concerned we expect that the domestic sales are expected to post a lower single digit growth in this year as the Country expects a good monsoon this year which is expected to increase higher farm incomes and a lift in the rural economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for commercial vehicles is expected to improve starting from fiscal year 2024-25.
demand_outlook.quote: With promising GDP growth outlook, incentives from government to improve productivity in both manufacturing and agriculture sectors, and continuing focus on infra, demand for CVs is expected to improve from FY 2024-25.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incorporated GNA Mobility Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to expand into broader automotive components and diversify its portfolio.
capex_expansion.quote: In 2025, we incorporated GNA Mobility Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to expand our presence in automotive components.

capex_expansion.claim: The company enhanced its rooftop solar capacity to 6 MW.
capex_expansion.quote: Enhanced our rooftop solar capacity to 6 MW

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 13.68% for the year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company reported selling 3,882,041 rear axle shafts, 1,105,733 spindles, and 327,019 other shafts in 2024-25.
orders_capacity.quote:
3,882,041 Rear Axle Shafts Sold in 2024-25
1,105,733 Spindles sold in 2024-25
327,019 Other Shafts sold in 2024-25

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of ` 3 per equity share for 2024-25.

management_commitments.claim: The company is executing a 3 MW rooftop solar project.
management_commitments.quote: Continuing this trajectory, a 3 MW rooftop solar project is currently under execution, reinforcing our dedication to expanding clean energy infrastructure.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand its solar capacity further in fiscal 2024-25.
management_commitments.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
